mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (GDP demand) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <50% of quarters with GDPC1 increases, or negative returns in >70% of such instances (p<0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns turn negative due to anticipated inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in GDPC1 (GDP demand) and monthly decline in FEDFUNDS signal an economic expansion, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 rises and FEDFUNDS falls, 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession labor market recovery regime, a monthly rise in UNRATE above 4.0% predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to improved labor conditions.
failure_condition: In post-recession regime, UNRATE rises above 4% but 20d returns are not positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in INDPRO (supply index) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as stronger production signals growth.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises but 5d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST crosses above 1500 units, S&P 500 20-day forward returns turn positive due to heightened demand signals.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when HOUST crosses above 1500 (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in GDPC1 (GDP demand) and PAYEMS (labor employment) signal robust economic activity, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and PAYEMS rise, 60d returns are not significantly positive (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a monthly decline in FEDFUNDS below 5.0% predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns as policy eases.
failure_condition: In tightening regime, FEDFUNDS <5% but 20d returns are not positive (p>0.05).
